ClientResponses.Response:
Thank you for your feedback. We are sorry to hear that the Weber Q1200 has been a disappointment thus far but look forward to helping solve this issue. 

We would like to hear more about this experience. Please lookout for an email from our Support team.
ClientResponses.Name: Weber Grills

Results.ReviewText: The attachment for the gas bottle on my barbecue was leaking and not usable. I contacted Weber and was mailed a replacement part. All good except I had to pay a handyman 75.00 to install the new parts given the necessity of safety. Due to all of this I had no barbecue for the 4th of July and with the added cost of installing the warranty part my barbecue thus far has cost significantly more than anticipated. The truth is it is so disappointing to receive a brand new product that right off the bat has issues that require repair.
Results.Title: Warranty Repair

Results.ReviewText: I had been debating on a new barbeque for a new condo/apartment unit that I purchased that would fit nicely on the balcony and to keep within the condo board restrictions. I decided on the Q1200, and I made a great choice. Easy to assemble; including the stand. Easy to move around and cooks with ease due to the convection style dome. Highly recommend this unit.
Results.Title: Weber Q1200, what a great little barbeque.

Results.ReviewText: The Weber Q1200 heats up quickly and consistently to 450/500 deg, and you can maintain a lower temperature. Just know temps can dip fast if you open the grill and keep it open. It’s a small grill so you won’t have separate temp zones for doing high and low heat, but be creative and you can accomplish the same thing, eg I set up indirect heat by putting a steel box and grate and cooking on that above the Q1200 grill. This little grill can cook food for up to 4 people, and cleans up so easily. Also got the rolling cart, haven’t used it to travel but it works for me as my grill station. I can hang tongs, a cleaning brush, and put plates of food on the side tables. Highly recommend!
Results.Title: Weber Q1200 is amazing!

Results.ReviewText: This grill is AWESOME! I used for the 1st time Saturday and was absolutely the best cooking experience I have ever had on a gas grill.
Results.Title: Best Experience Ever

Results.ReviewText: I have had this bbq for almost two months now it has gone everywhere with me. The Selling feature for me was how light weight it is and the extra space you have with the folding arms. Great price to add to a travellers gear.
Results.Title: Amazing little bbq

Results.ReviewText: I have 4 of these bbqs, vacation rentals. They use very little propane and throw amazing heat
Results.Title: Small but mighty

Results.ReviewText: Easy assembly and lit right up. Plenty of heat for searing your favorite steak. Great quality, portability and easy to clean.
Results.Title: Very Pleased

Results.ReviewText: Excellent even heating and cooking. The quality expected of a Weber. Portability and consistent cooking performance. Would highly recommend.
Results.Title: Excellent even heating and cooking

Results.ReviewText: The grill is everything we hoped for! It’s light, making it easy to take up and down stairs, and to places like the beach. The heat distribution is great, which means there isn’t a bad spot in the grill to cook meats or veggies. Finally, it’s very durable and incredibly easy to clean.
Results.Title: Mighty and portable grill

Results.ReviewText: It's small and mighty..small in size ..easy to use ..its portable great for smaller spaces
Results.Title: Small and mighty

Results.ReviewText: Yeah, it’s smaller than some but that make it easily portable.  This thing produces a lot of heat: ample for cooking whatever you want.  We like it for it’s portability (it is light at about 26 pounds) and the simple, effective design.  Love the foldout side trays, drippings pan, and the ability to use 1lb and 20lb fuel tanks - with optional adapter hose, my advice: get the hose for options).
Results.Title: Perfect portability and plenty of heat

Results.ReviewText: This is the second Q 1200 gas grill that I have purchased.  It is great for one or two people, but can accommodate up to four easily.  My only two comments are, I wish it had two burners for indirect cooking.  I bought the 1200 instead of the 1000 because of the attached side tables.  My older 1200 had larger side tables.  The size of the side tables on this grill purchased in 2022 are so small they are barely useable.  I am going to have to buy another outside table in order to have enough room for a full size dish and grilling accessories.  Big disappointment because I purchased the grill online and so did not see it.  Otherwise, it is a great product for someone who does not need a large size  grill.
Results.Title: Great grill, attached side tables too small

Results.ReviewText:
We bought this BBQ about a month ago and then took it camping for 5 nights.
It did everything we asked of it, heated up quickly and maintained a very even heat.
Wqs a good purchase.
Results.Title: Great Product

Results.ReviewText: Acheter le mois dernier pour remplacer mon vieux bbq et vraiment satisfaite
Results.Title: Petit mais très pratique

Results.ReviewText: This little grill is fantastic, we’re using it when camping (we’ll be using it on our road trip this weekend). Like our large Weber grill at home, this little grill has the same quality built in a smaller form - cooking on it is fantastic.
Results.Title: Enjoying our Weber Grill

Results.ReviewText: I am very impressed with this grill.  Great size to take camp but still take care of my needs at home.  Even temperature for perfect cooking.
Results.Title: Great Grill

Photos.Caption: Love how evenly this little thing cooks!

Results.ReviewText: I love this grill! It is amazing to me that it performs as well as a full size Weber. I bought it for camping and I m so glad I did. Burgers, dogs and chicken all were perfect. What really amazes me is how evenly it cooks. Definitely not for a large crowd, but perfect for a family. Also, it fits perfectly into a blue Ikea bag for transport. I love it!
Results.Title: Small, but awesome!

Results.ReviewText:
Best Grills Ever. Cusomer Support. Great...Cooks good and very good even for the size !
Thanks Weber.
Results.Title: Weber® Q 1200 Gas Grill

Results.ReviewText: Super fast heating to temperature & easy to use. Cleaning is quick with no effort to move around.
Results.Title: Great little camp bbq

Results.ReviewText: I'm on my second one.  Grill almost every week all year round.  They are great for burgers and dogs and steaks. They are still cheap enough that I just buy a new one every 5 years or so. Gave the last one away it was still going strong.  You keep making them like this and in this price range and I'll keep buying them.  See you in about 4 years. Also bought one for my brother and he loves it.  He uses his weekly all year round too.  Fits in the corner of his covered porch so all weather use.  I just use an umbrella.
Results.Title: On my second one. Love these babies

Results.ReviewText: The grill heats evenly and hasn't flared up.  I've cooked hamburgers and chicken multiple times love it.
Results.Title: Great grill.   Work every penny.
